    print(" wall x", wall[:,0].min().round(4), wall[:,0].max().round(4), "y", wall[:,1].min().round(4), wall[:,1].max().round(4))

def chk(pv, held=None, every=3, ignore=()):
    qs = pv["q"][::every] + [pv["q"][-1]]
    cs = ep.check_batch(qs, held=held, ignore=ignore)
    bad = [(i, [(c["link"], c["obstacle"], round(c["clearance_m"],4)) for c in r["contacts"]]) for i, r in enumerate(cs) if not r["collision_free"]]

def plan_lag_move(tcp_target, duration, thresh=0.0003, grip=1):

    qcmd = qt + comp

    pv_ = ep.preview([rh.waypoint(duration, list(tcp_cmd), grip)])
    qend = np.array(pv_["q"][-1])
